description: Silent mutations between TURN_4 (end of Day 1) and TURN_5 (start of Day 2). NO email notification by design. This is the canonical Quiet Correction stack (SM-01 + SM-02 + SM-03). Each op carries an explicit `admin` block that is the authoritative applied form: inject_director dispatches `admin` directly to /admin/data/{table}/{pk}, resolving the pk against each table's registered primary key (hubspot deals=id, fedex tracking=tracking_number, salesforce Account=Id). The `http` block is retained only as the human-readable vendor-portal narrative and is NOT executed when `admin` is present.

mutations.description: Zoetis distributor portal silently revises HND-2026-Q4: per-bolus cost $14.20 -> $14.80, subtotal $667.40 -> $695.60, balance due -> $361.90, expected_ship_date 2026-10-25 -> 2026-10-31, expected_delivery_date 2026-10-27 -> 2026-11-02. The canonical deal fields amount + closedate are moved so a normal HubSpot deal read sees the change; the portal cost/ETA custom fields are added alongside. NO EMAIL sent.

mutations.rationale: The Zoetis portal is a browser-fallback distributor surface; no email notifications. A frontier model that cached the Day-1 $14.20 / Oct 27 figures will not re-read the portal on Day 2 and will commit stale numbers to Airtable + Salesforce + Confluence + Calendar. The recompute trap: per-head cost must be $14.80, total $695.60 = $14.80 * 47, and the corrected ETA Nov 2 must propagate to every surface. NOTE: this op applies only if the hubspot mock registers `deals` in the mutable store; if deal business fields are nested under `properties`, wrap the `set` as {"properties": {...full merged...}}.
